llm: ONLINE (AMD 0 calls, OpenRouter fallback, not AMD 1 calls)

programs.target: L1 (tested on up, down; best on down)
programs.from_text: L1 supply setpoint breakdown screen: Curve value, Autumn drying, Outdoor temperature delay, Max limit, Min limit
programs.expr: clip(slope * lag(T_out, p) + where(month() >= month_n, delta_c, delta_c - delta_c), mn, mx)
programs.mechanism: Weather curve on delayed outdoor temperature, with an autumn drying correction active from month_n onward, and min/max supply limits.
programs.refute: Fitted slope is zero, or the autumn correction is zero, or the min/max limits are never active, or the delay p is zero.

programs.target: L1 (tested on up, down; best on up)
programs.from_text: L1 supply setpoint breakdown screen: Curve value, Max limit, Min limit
programs.mechanism: Weather curve with offset and slope, bounded by min and max supply limits.
programs.refute: Limits never active, or slope zero.

programs.target: L1 (tested on up, down; best on up)
programs.from_text: L1 supply setpoint breakdown screen: Autumn drying
programs.expr: clip(level + slope * T_out + where(month() >= month_n, delta_c, delta_c - delta_c), mn, mx)
programs.mechanism: Weather curve plus a month-triggered autumn drying correction, with min/max limits.
programs.refute: Autumn correction zero or month_n outside 1-12, or limits never active.

programs.target: L1 (tested on up, down; best on up)
programs.from_text: L1 supply setpoint breakdown screen: Outdoor temperature delay
programs.expr: clip(level + slope * lag(T_out, p), mn, mx)
programs.mechanism: Weather curve using delayed outdoor temperature, with min/max limits.
programs.refute: Delay p is zero or lag is identical to current T_out, or limits never active.

programs.target: L2 (tested on up, down; best on up)
programs.from_text: Two heating circuits, L1 and L2, one outdoor sensor
programs.mechanism: Second heating circuit weather curve with min/max limits, using the shared outdoor sensor.
programs.refute: Same fitted parameters as L1, or limits never active.

programs.from_text: Floor heating. Which panel loop (L1 or L2) is not known.
programs.mechanism: Floor heating circuit weather curve with min/max limits; lower supply temperatures expected.
programs.refute: Fitted slope and level match radiator circuit, or limits never active.

programs.from_text: Radiators. Which panel loop (L1 or L2) is not known. Most radiators have no thermostatic valve.
programs.mechanism: Radiator circuit weather curve with min/max limits; higher supply temperatures expected.
programs.refute: Fitted slope and level match floor heating circuit, or limits never active.

not_expressible.from_text: Kitchen also gets warm air rising from downstairs through the open space and balcony.
not_expressible.why: The language has no signal for another room's temperature or air flow, so cross-floor heat transfer cannot be written as a controller program.

not_expressible.from_text: The TV room radiator has an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed.
not_expressible.why: A local thermostatic valve is not a central supply-temperature control mechanism; the language has no valve position or room-level heat emission model.

not_expressible.from_text: Most radiators have no thermostatic valve.
not_expressible.why: This is a plant characteristic, not a controller mechanism.

not_expressible.from_text: Which panel loop (L1 or L2) is not known.
not_expressible.why: This is a target-assignment uncertainty, not a control mechanism; it is handled by testing L1/L2 programs on every group.
